chunks: And everything in it that is narrated from Abdullah ibn Latif Al-Taflisi, I have narrated it from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur - may Allah be pleased with him - from Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amir, from his uncle Abdullah ibn Amir, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Latif Al-Taflisi.

key_terms.جعفر بن محمّد بن مسرور: Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur, a key link in the transmission from the author.
key_terms.رضي اللّه عنه: May Allah be pleased with him, an honorific used for the narrator Jafar ibn Masrur.
key_terms.عبد اللّه بن لطيف التفليسي: Abdullah ibn Latif Al-Taflisi, a narrator whose chain is being clarified.
key_terms.عمّه: His uncle, referring to the relationship between Abdullah ibn Amir and Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amir.

ai.seo_question: How is the transmission chain for Abdullah ibn Latif Al-Taflisi's narrations verified in this text?
ai.summary: This passage exemplifies the rigorous methodology of *al-istifrad* (collecting all variants) employed by Shaykh al-Saduq to authenticate the reliability of Abdullah ibn Latif Al-Taflisi, a key narrator in the Imami tradition. By explicitly tracing the chain from himself back to the original source, al-Saduq provides a transparent *isnad* that reinforces the credibility of the transmitted knowledge within the context of early Shia hadith scholarship.
